status_honesty_statement: Meroitic Corpus v0.1 is a typed, schema-validated, anti-leakage-checked machine-readable corpus built from currently digitized primary sources (Hallof Vol. 7 excerpt REM 0001–0092, all 3 Royal Narratives across 4 unmerged witnesses, Otten cleaned Millet/Rilly/Lobban examples, stratified Rilly Gold Certain lexicon, 95 bilingual Egyptian pairs, and Rilly 2010 / ASJP v20 Proto-NES comparative data). It is NOT the full 2,000-text REM corpus yet: REM 0093–2780 (Hallof print) and Rilly 2003 Vol. II (~800 entries) remain open ingestion slots awaiting publisher/author files and permission clearance.

sources_and_permissions.title: Jochen Hallof (2024), Analytisches Wörterbuch des Meroitischen, Band 7: Dokumente (Excerpt REM 0001–0092)
sources_and_permissions.notes: Publisher J.H. Röll GmbH & author Jochen Hallof. Permission email being sent on the side; tagged pending-permission.

sources_and_permissions.title: Joshua Otten Meroitic-Corpus — 3 Royal Narratives (REM 1044, REM 1003, REM 0094 × 2 witnesses)
sources_and_permissions.notes: Real narrative files from GitHub Joshua-Otten/Meroitic-Corpus (no license file). Synthetic mero-corpus.txt (17,257 lines) strictly quarantined.

sources_and_permissions.title: Otten Meroitic-Corpus — MilletExamples.txt, RillyExamples.txt, LobbanVocabList.txt & 7 Bilingual Dicts
sources_and_permissions.notes: Source-tagged by file and page citation; LobbanVocabList explicitly flagged unverified-citation.

sources_and_permissions.title: Claude Rilly (2003/2007/2010/2016) — Gold Certain Meroitic Core Lexicon
sources_and_permissions.notes: Verified certain-grade scholarly consensus entries with Egyptian loanwords flagged separately.

sources_and_permissions.notes: CC BY-SA 4.0. Strictly tagged proto_status="reconstructed", never mixed into Meroitic attestations.

sources_and_permissions.title: ASJP v20 CLDF — Northern Eastern Sudanic (Nubian, Nara, Taman, Nyimang)
sources_and_permissions.notes: CC BY 4.0 open comparative lexical dataset across 18 authentic NES varieties.
